description: Use this when the user asks for aggregate AI signal performance statistics over a specific period — overall, or for one strategy (preset) by name. The answer also breaks the period down per strategy (byStrategy), which is how to learn the strategy names for get_signals.

strategy.description: Only the signals of one AI strategy (preset), matched by part of its name, case-insensitive.

name: get_signal_stats

strategyName.description: The preset — pass it to get_signals as `strategy`

winRate.description: targetHits / resolved, as a percentage; null when nothing resolved

byStrategy.description: The same counts per strategy (preset) that fired in the period, most signals first

pending.description: Still open at the end of the period

strategy.description: The strategy filter that was applied, if any

targetHits.description: Signals that reached a take-profit or locked profit

warning.description: Set when a strategy filter could not be applied or matched nothing (with the closest preset names)

winRate.description: targetHits / resolved, as a percentage; null when nothing resolved
